description: This file defines a class for an AWS Bedrock Knowledge Base Retriever node, including its properties, constructor, methods for loading regions, and initialization logic for creating a retriever instance with credentials and parameters.

classes.name: AWSBedrockKBRetriever_Retrievers
classes.description: Implements a node for retrieving knowledge base data from AWS Bedrock, with configuration for credentials, region, and retrieval options.

methods.name: loadMethods.listRegions
methods.description: Asynchronously loads available AWS regions for embeddings using the getRegions utility.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes and returns an AmazonKnowledgeBaseRetriever instance configured with credentials, region, and other parameters.
